# InviterLink Bot

> Telegram bot for timezone-aware meeting scheduling with reminders & DMs

## Overview

InviterLink Bot creates meeting cards with multi-timezone time conversion (7 cities, DST-aware), Google Calendar links, scheduled reminders (45 min and 5 min before), and personal DMs to participants via Telethon.

## Stack

- Python + Flask (serverless on Vercel)
- pyTelegramBotAPI (Telegram Bot API)
- Telethon (userbot for DMs)
- QStash / Redis (Upstash) — reminders & allowlist
- zoneinfo — DST-aware timezone conversion
